title: Lahaina Maritime Inc
specs: Fishing at Fish Aggregation Devices 20-40 miles offshore
Target species include mahi-mahi, yellowfin and big eye tuna, marlin, spearfish, and ono
Age 10 and up for sportfishing, 8 and up for bottom fishing
Hawai‘i recreational ocean fishing license required for non-residents (cost $20 for 1-day, $40 for 7-day, $70 annual)
Private charters preferred; share trips available for some 6 hour and 4 hour trips with max 4 guests
gap: Exact prices for each trip not stated
blurb: Guests join fishing charters departing early morning to fish offshore at Fish Aggregation Devices targeting pelagic game fish such as mahi-mahi, tuna, marlin, and ono. Trips range from inshore trolling to full-day deep sea fishing. The vessel is open air and accommodates up to 6 guests, with private charters preferred.
extraNote: Cancellations up to 72 hours prior to excursion allowed · Gratuity of 15-20% customary · General Excise tax of 4.7120% added to cost · Full refund if share trip does not fill by 2 days before departure · Lahaina Maritime slip 67, 101 Maalaea Road, Wailuku, Hawaii 96793
